pathway.title: Study and market a medical device

clinical.title: IDE responsibilities, IRB and informed consent

workflows.title: Quality governance & management review
workflows.applicability: QMS scope and manufacturer role determine applicability
workflows.summary: Record responsibilities, quality objectives, review inputs, decisions, and follow-through.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
QMS scope, sites, and responsibilities
Management-review inputs and quality metrics
Decisions, resources, and accountable owners
Prior actions and effectiveness follow-up

workflows.title: Document & record control
workflows.applicability: For controlled quality documents and required records
workflows.summary: Control document versions, approvals, distribution, retention, and reliable retrieval.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Document ID, version, and change rationale
Review and approval responsibilities
Effective date, distribution, and obsolete-copy controls
Retention rationale, access, backup, and retrieval test

workflows.title: Training & competence
workflows.applicability: Competence requirements follow each role and task
workflows.summary: Connect procedure revisions to training, competence checks, and retraining.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Person or role and assigned activity
Procedure and exact revision
Training method, completion date, and trainer
Competence assessment and results
Retraining triggers and next review

workflows.title: Supplier qualification & monitoring
workflows.applicability: Risk-based controls for purchased products and outsourced processes
workflows.summary: Document supplier risk, evaluation, purchasing requirements, and ongoing performance.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Supplier identity and supplied product/process
Supplier risk and selection criteria
Evaluation or audit results and approval decision
Purchasing specifications and quality agreement
Monitoring results, re-evaluation date, and escalation

workflows.title: Design transfer & change control
workflows.applicability: Design/development applicability and exemptions require review
workflows.summary: Assess affected designs, risks, verification, transfer, and regulatory consequences.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Change description, rationale, and affected configurations
Affected requirements, risks, lots, procedures, and training
Regulatory impact and submission assessment
Verification/validation plan and results
Transfer, approvals, implementation, and effectiveness

workflows.title: Risk register & control verification
workflows.applicability: Risk management across the applicable product lifecycle
workflows.summary: Track a hazard, its controls, residual risk, and production feedback.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Hazard, hazardous situation, and sequence of events
Severity, probability, and justified acceptance criteria
Risk controls and linked design/process requirements
Control verification and residual-risk assessment
Production/post-production signals and review decision

workflows.title: Production history & release review
workflows.applicability: For devices/batches within manufacturing scope
workflows.summary: Assemble device history, acceptance, labeling, deviations, and authorized disposition.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Device, configuration, UDI/other ID, and lot/serial
Manufacturing dates, quantities, and source materials
In-process/final inspection and acceptance results
Nonconformances, rework, and disposition
Label/packaging revision and inspection
Release decision, accountable person, and date

workflows.title: Process validation & revalidation
workflows.applicability: When process results cannot be fully verified subsequently
workflows.summary: Plan validation, acceptance criteria, execution, deviations, and revalidation.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Process, intended result, and validation rationale
Protocol, risk, sampling, and acceptance criteria
Installation/operation/performance qualification as applicable
Results, deviations, and disposition
Validated state, change controls, and revalidation triggers

workflows.title: Calibration & equipment impact
workflows.applicability: For equipment affecting product quality or acceptance
workflows.summary: Capture calibration/maintenance and assess product impact from out-of-tolerance equipment.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Instrument ID, location, and intended use
Method, reference standards, and traceability
Calibration/maintenance date, performer, and results
Out-of-tolerance assessment and affected records/lots
Next due date, status, and follow-up actions

workflows.title: Environment & contamination control
workflows.applicability: Where environment, cleanliness, or contamination affects quality
workflows.summary: Define environmental controls, monitoring, excursions, and product impact.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Area/process and required environmental conditions
Cleanliness, contamination, personnel, and facility controls
Monitoring method, limits, frequency, and results
Excursions, product assessment, and corrective follow-up

workflows.title: Labeling & packaging controls
workflows.applicability: 21 CFR 820.45 and applicable device-labeling rules
workflows.summary: Review identity, expiry, instructions, integrity, mix-up prevention, and release.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Device ID/UDI and approved label/packaging revisions
Expiry, storage, handling, and processing instructions
Packaging integrity and inspection results
Line clearance, mix-up prevention, and reconciliation
Label/packaging release authorization and date

workflows.title: Storage & distribution traceability
workflows.applicability: Preservation, identification, and traceability as applicable
workflows.summary: Trace storage conditions, shipped lots, destinations, and recovery capability.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Device/UDI, lot/serial, and quantities
Storage/handling requirements and condition records
Shipment date, destination, consignee, and trace records
Returns, stock status, and recall traceability assessment

workflows.title: Nonconformance & disposition
workflows.applicability: For nonconforming product/process outputs
workflows.summary: Control containment, impact, disposition, rework, and verified acceptance.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Nonconformance, specification, and affected device/lot
Quarantine, segregation, and immediate containment
Scope, product risk, and investigation
Authorized disposition and any concession rationale
Rework/reinspection results and CAPA escalation decision

workflows.title: CAPA & effectiveness
workflows.applicability: Corrective/preventive action proportional to risk and cause
workflows.summary: Investigate causes, implement actions, and verify effectiveness before closure.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Problem statement, data source, and containment
Root-cause investigation and supporting evidence
Action plan, owners, due dates, and change links
Verification/validation that actions do not create adverse effects
Effectiveness criteria, observation period, results, and conclusion

workflows.title: Complaint intake & investigation
workflows.applicability: Complaint handling and applicable 21 CFR 820.35 records
workflows.summary: Capture device/event facts, investigate, assess reportability, and follow through.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Device name, UDI/UPC or other identification, lot/serial
Date complaint received and event date if known
Complainant name/contact reference; protect personal data in controlled records
Nature and details of complaint
Investigation dates/results, or documented reason and responsible decision not to investigate
MDR assessment, rationale, awareness date, and reporting follow-up
Correction/CAPA, reply to complainant, and responsible reviewer

workflows.title: MDR assessment & submission tracking
workflows.applicability: Manufacturer/importer role and reportability determine requirements
workflows.summary: Track human reportability decisions, regulatory clocks, submissions, and follow-up.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Device/event, awareness date, and reporter role
Death/serious-injury/malfunction evaluation and rationale
Applicable 30-calendar-day or 5-work-day assessment; confirm the regulatory deadline
Submission date, eMDR acknowledgement/reference, or justified non-reportability
Additional information, supplemental reports, and responsible follow-up

workflows.title: Corrections, removals & recall coordination
workflows.applicability: 21 CFR 806 reporting and exceptions require assessment
workflows.summary: Connect health-risk assessment, affected distribution, notification, and effectiveness.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Correction/removal description, initiation date, and device IDs
Health-risk and reportability assessment with rationale
Affected lots/serials, quantities, and consignees
10-working-day reporting assessment, submission reference, or documented exception
Approved communications and execution records
Reconciliation, effectiveness checks, and closure assessment

workflows.title: Postmarket feedback & trend review
workflows.applicability: Feedback/trending plus device-specific postmarket obligations
workflows.summary: Review complaint, service, and field data for risk and CAPA signals.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Feedback sources, population, and observation period
Trend method, denominators, thresholds, and limitations
Findings, risk impact, and reportability assessments
Escalation/CAPA/change actions and follow-up review

workflows.title: Internal/supplier audit & findings
workflows.applicability: Audit program within applicable QMS scope
workflows.summary: Plan audits, preserve findings, and track responses and verified follow-up.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Audit scope, criteria, schedule, and independence
Reviewed records, interviews, and objective evidence
Findings, requirement mapping, and significance
Corrections/CAPA, owners, and due dates
Follow-up verification and audit conclusions

workflows.title: Registration, listing & authorization
workflows.applicability: Depends on establishment activities, device, and exemptions
workflows.summary: Track legal manufacturer role, marketing pathway, listing, and annual renewal.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Establishment activities, sites, and responsible legal entities
Device description, product code/class, and exemptions rationale
Applicable marketing authorization and identifier, or exemption rationale
Registration/listing identifiers and verification evidence
Annual review/renewal responsibility and due dates

workflows.title: UDI & device-identification record
workflows.applicability: Device labeler obligations and exceptions require review
workflows.summary: Record identifiers, packaging hierarchy, labeling, and applicable GUDID submissions.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Device/model/version and responsible labeler
UDI-DI, production identifiers, and applicable exceptions
Packaging levels and direct-marking assessment
GUDID data review, submission reference/status, or exception rationale
Label/identifier verification and change controls

workflows.title: QMS software assurance & electronic records
workflows.applicability: For production/QMS software; Part 11 scope is separately assessed
workflows.summary: Define intended use, risk-based assurance, record controls, and change verification.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
System/version, intended use, and regulated process
Process risk, failure impact, and assurance rationale
Assurance activities, objective results, and unresolved issues
Part 11 applicability, access, record history, retention, and signature assessment
Release decision, backup/restore evidence, and change controls

workflows.title: Device cybersecurity & vulnerability response
workflows.applicability: For devices with cybersecurity risk; 524B applies to cyber devices
workflows.summary: Track threat models, components, vulnerabilities, remediation, and lifecycle evidence.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Device/software version and cybersecurity/524B applicability
Threat model, security architecture, and risk controls
SBOM/component inventory and vulnerability assessment
Security verification and unresolved anomalies
Monitoring, coordinated disclosure, patches, and support lifecycle

workflows.title: Installation & servicing record
workflows.applicability: Where installation or servicing activities apply
workflows.summary: Preserve device identity, service date/personnel, work, testing, and complaint escalation.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Device name, UDI/UPC/other ID, and lot/serial
Service/installation date and individuals performing work
Reported issue and service performed
Test and inspection data with acceptance conclusion
Complaint/MDR assessment and follow-up actions

workflows.title: Clinical investigation & study operations
workflows.applicability: Only where human-subject research/clinical investigation applies
workflows.summary: Track applicable study authorization, oversight, conduct, and safety reporting.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Protocol/version, investigational device, and study objective
IDE/exemption/significant-risk assessment and regulatory status
IRB, informed-consent controls, monitoring, and responsible personnel
Study conduct, data integrity, and deviations
Safety reporting, device accountability, and closure obligations

workflows.title: Product-specific safety & performance evidence
workflows.applicability: Requirements depend on intended use, materials, technology, and risk
workflows.summary: Plan applicable performance, biocompatibility, sterility, usability, and shelf-life evidence.

fields.label: Applicability and regulatory rationale
Intended use, users, environment, and product configuration
Applicable safety/performance standards and justified exclusions
Methods, representative articles, and acceptance criteria
Performance, usability, biocompatibility, sterility or shelf-life results as applicable
Deviations, remaining gaps, risk assessment, and reviewer conclusion
